biography: Prof. Dr. K. Palanikumar (M.E., Ph.D., FIE) is Professor and Principal at Sri Sai Ram Institute of Technology, Chennai, India. His specialization is Mechanical / Manufacturing Engineering, and his research interests are composite materials (processing, applications and natural fibers), total quality management and optimization.

He holds an A.M.I.E. in Mechanical Engineering from the Institution of Engineers (India), an M.E. in Production Engineering from Annamalai University with University First Rank, and a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering from the College of Engineering Guindy, Anna University, Chennai. He also holds a Post Diploma in Tool Design from Central Polytechnic, Chennai, and completed post-doctoral research on the machining of composites with Prof. J. Paulo Davim at the University of Aveiro, Portugal. He is a Chartered Engineer of the Institution of Engineers (India).

His teaching and research career began in 1994 at Sathyabama Engineering College / Sathyabama University, Chennai, where he served as Lecturer, Assistant Professor and Professor until 2004. He then served as Professor and Principal at S.R.R. Engineering College (2004–2008) and has been Senior Professor and Principal at Sri Sai Ram Institute of Technology since 2008. His other experience includes four years as Lab Instructor at Sathyabama Engineering College and three years of industrial experience.

His profile records 310 Scopus/WoS-indexed research articles (Scopus citations 10,310; h-index 53) and 353 Scopus/WoS/Google Scholar-indexed research articles (Google Scholar citations 15,688; h-index 65), 21 granted patents, funding of around 2 Crores from funding agencies, and 21 Ph.D. scholars guided. He is listed among the World's Top 2% Scientists compiled by Stanford University, received the AICTE Visvesvaraya National Award for Best Teacher (2021), and holds the Global Peer Review Award from Web of Science.

He has served as Chairman of the Institution of Engineers (India), Kancheepuram Chapter, serves as a committee member for Mechanical Engineering at the Institution of Engineers (India), Tamilnadu State Centre, and is a National Executive Committee Member of the Indian Society for Technical Education. He has edited many books on engineering and technology and four conference proceedings.
